surface_follow.label: Follow surfaces
surface_follow.description: Dragging moves the view center along terrain and object surfaces. Turn it off to keep the current height and pass through obstacles.

ray_steps.label: Ray steps
ray_steps.description: Colors each pixel by the nodes its own ray walked from its cell's start: blue few, red many, the same ramp on every screen. Grey where it took a sample's block and walked nothing.
